description: A living map of your code: plain-language summaries above functions, highlighted steps inside them, callers and callees, and jumps from a frontend button to its backend handler.
config.codeLens.enabled: Show the summary, callers and what the function reaches above each function.
config.hover.enabled: Show the summary, layer, callers and callees when hovering a call or a function name. Never calls a model.
config.layerStripes.enabled: Color stripe on the left of lines that call into another layer (handler, service, data, external API).
config.blocks.enabled: Highlight the meaningful steps inside long functions.
config.blocks.style: How the steps inside a function are shown.
config.summaryLanguage: Language for "Explain in more depth" (ru, en, …). Empty: summaries.language from clewmap.config.json.
config.blocks.style.0: Alternating background and a label at the end of the first line of each step
color.blockTintA: Background of odd steps inside a function.
color.blockTintB: Background of even steps inside a function.
color.blockSeparator: Thin line between steps inside a function.
color.blockLabel: Label of a step at the end of its first line.
color.changedBackground: Background of lines touched by the last commit.
